note: Both sets cover the same nine drivetrain facts from the text and Table 5-1 with correct values, units and bindings, and both repeat each fact once from the prose and once from the table. The only differences are cosmetic: A labels the table row 'Rotor | Rated Speed' and the brake torque row 'fully-deployed torque', while B keeps the fuller labels 'Rated Rotor Speed' and 'Fully-Deployed Brake Torque' (with the fully-deployed condition), which is marginally more faithful but not materially different. Both equally miss the 5% critical structural-damping ratio of the driveshaft and the 5,025,500 kg•m2 DOWEC equivalent low-speed-shaft inertia. Neither set contains a misread, misbound or invented claim.
remarks: Both extractions pair every Table 5-1 row with its prose sentence, producing systematic text/table duplication (9 facts stated 17 times). Both omit the driveshaft structural-damping ratio of 5% critical (free-free mode, rigid generator and rigid rotor) and the DOWEC equivalent low-speed-shaft generator inertia of 5,025,500 kg•m2; the driveshaft natural frequency is stated only as 'same as the RECOFF turbine model' with no value, so it is correctly not extracted.
